turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there, how have things been?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My back hurts after every workday at the kitchen table.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That table is probably the wrong height. Would you rather invest in a proper office chair first, or a standing desk?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Give me a second, my brother needs help with something. Stay quiet until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Theo, how do you say I'm hungry in German again?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Ich habe Hunger. Literally, I have hunger.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's so weird. Why not just I am hungry?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Same with thirst. Lots of languages do it that way.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, ich habe Hunger. Did I say it right?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Pretty close. Make the H a bit softer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you take the trash out?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not yet, I'll do it now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Right. So, which one for your back?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The chair. I sit most of the day anyway.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then get one with adjustable lumbar support, and try it before you buy if you can.
